verdict.rationale: Helicone's core value proposition is automatic logging/tracing of LLM requests with one-line/two-line SDK integration, capturing inputs, outputs, costs, and enabling debugging of latency/failures, corroborated by both docs and independent HN users who confirm easy integration and use for debugging/analytics. Token usage and cost tracking are implied throughout (pricing, gateway, observability features) and community reports confirm real-world use for exactly this purpose. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party screenshot/doc excerpt naming 'token usage' field directly, though strongly implied via cost/observability language.
